name: Printing
summary: Print from campus computers and personal devices

details.title: Student printing
details.html: Active students can print in participating labs and libraries using a YU-card or supported mobile credential for payment. The current source page lists black-and-white printing at 10 cents per page and colour at 25 cents per page. Verify charges before submitting large jobs

details.title: WebPrint
details.html: WebPrint lets students submit documents from a laptop or desktop browser to supported public campus printers over the campus network. You need an active Passport York account and sufficient printing balance

details.title: Departmental printing
details.html: Staff and faculty printing, network printer setup and associated access depend on the department’s managed printing arrangements and equipment. Contact your local IT team for printer provisioning and permissions
